title: Split Guard-Rail Playbook and Failure Scenario Timeline Prototype
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Prototype and interaction spec for a guided ‘Split Guard-Rail Playbook’ integrated into the Redwood Console rollout flow. Focus: give engineers and PMs a concise, low-friction authoring surface for traffic-splits (canary/A-B/percent-based ramps) plus a time-based failure-scenario simulator that projects user-visible impact, alerts, and cost delta. This artifact covers wireframes, microcopy, keyboard interactions, accessibility considerations, gating metrics, and emergency rollback affordances.

Goals:
- Provide a single view where teams author multi-step traffic ramps (step, duration, hold, verification) and attach hypothesis + metrics for each step.
- Visualize a timeline that simulates failure modes (spike in errors, latency drift, cost surge) and shows automated guard-rail responses (pause, revert, notify).
- Surface a one-click emergency rollback and a fast-snapback with prefilled reason templates and suggested remediation playbook entries.
- Make safety assertions explorable: which metrics triggered a pause, how long it took, and which fallback model or region was selected.
- Integrate with Console dashboards: link to per-route latency/cost/token breakdowns, and to the Optimize recommendations for quantization/batching when cost surges are simulated.

Key interactions and screens included in prototype:
- Playbook Composer: drag-to-reorder steps, inline metric thresholds, and a compact hypothesis field.
- Timeline Simulator: animated time-scrub that shows system state, active guard-rail, and predicted customer impact.
- Failure Scenario Library: curated presets (e.g., KV cache miss storm, kernel OOM, region outage, sudden traffic doubling) that populate simulated traces.
- Emergency Panel: persistent top-bar with quick-rollback, pause-all, and route-isolate buttons; confirmations use two-step modal with short-run explanation requirement.
- Audit and Runbook Export: export a CSV/Markdown audit trail for the rollout and quick-create a postmortem template linked to the timeline annotations.

Acceptance criteria:
- Design files include desktop and tablet layouts, annotated with keyboard shortcuts and aria roles.
- Prototype demonstrates a 3-step canary flow with simulated metric violations and an automated pause + rollback action.
- Usability script (5 tasks) written and scheduled with 6 participants (mix of platform engineers and PMs).
- Handoff-ready spec for engineering with component-level tokens and a list of observability hooks to implement.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: deep RBAC variations and the private/on-prem upgrade flow; those will be addressed in follow-ups.

2026-03-12: Polished prototype attached. Ready for design review and final sign-off pending engineering scoping of observability hooks.
